e.title: **日语车险查定实操课：把**四种性质不同的数据**放在同一个地方对撞**：仓库 `sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`——**⭐ 一句核心判断**：**「**価格マスタとの突合だけでは架空計上は見抜けず、画像分析だけでは単価の妥当性は判断できません**」**；**⭐ 而**记分规则被逐条写死****（**图像不一致 30 分／**单价超 15% 25 分／**工时指数超 30% 25 分／**零件号不在主数据 15 分**）**；**⭐ 五个案件给出了**判定与分数**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
e.title_en: A Japanese-language hands-on for non-life insurance claims adjustment that matches four kinds of differently shaped data in one place, with a written scoring rule for each fraud pattern, per-case verdicts and scores for five demonstration claims, and a stated reason why price-master matching alone cannot detect fabricated line items and image analysis alone cannot judge whether a unit price is reasonable.
e.title_hk: **日語車險查定實操課：把**四種性質不同的資料**放在同一個地方對撞**：倉庫 `sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`——**⭐ 一句核心判斷**：**「**価格マスタとの突合だけでは架空計上は見抜けず、画像分析だけでは単価の妥当性は判断できません**」**；**⭐ 而**記分規則被逐條寫死****（**圖像不一致 30 分／**單價超 15% 25 分／**工時指數超 30% 25 分／**零件號不在主數據 15 分**）**；**⭐ 五個案件給出了**判定與分數**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**、**★0**
e.summary: **claims-adjustment-cortex-handson**（`sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`，**日语**）**是一份**车险损害查定（協定業務）的 AI 实操课材料****——**逐字自述题材为**「**自動車事故の損害査定と修理見積の不正検知**」**，**并逐字点出方法上的关键**「**事故車の画像、修理工場から届く見積書PDF、部品定価・標準作業指数のリファレンスマスタ、そして保険約款という性質の異なる4種類のデータを1つのプラットフォーム上で突き合わせ**」**。**本次实测**：**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 28 条路径**（**5 张事故车图 ＋ **5 张参考图 ＋ **1 份约款 PDF ＋ **3 份估价单 PDF ＋ **两个 SQL 安装脚本 ＋ **一个 notebook 与两个 SQL**）**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **逐条写明「**哪种手口需要哪种数据**」**，**并给出**记分规则**；**② **五个案件**给出判定与分数**（**含一个总分 0 但需要**重拍照片**的案件**）**；**③ **实测耗时**逐段列出**（**SMALL 仓库下从零到全部跑完约 3 分半**）**。**⚠️ 全部数据自述为虚构。
e.summary_hk: **claims-adjustment-cortex-handson**（`sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`，**日語**）**是一份**車險損害查定（協定業務）的 AI 實操課材料****——**逐字自述題材為**「**自動車事故の損害査定と修理見積の不正検知**」**，**並逐字點出方法關鍵**「**事故車の画像、修理工場から届く見積書PDF、部品定価・標準作業指数のリファレンスマスタ、そして保険約款という性質の異なる4種類のデータを1つのプラットフォーム上で突き合わせ**」**。**本次實測**：**建立與最後推送同為 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 28 條路徑**（**5 張事故車圖 ＋** 5 張參考圖 ＋** 1 份約款 PDF ＋** 3 份估價單 PDF ＋** 兩個 SQL 安裝腳本 ＋** 一個 notebook 與兩個 SQL**）**；**⚠️ 無 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**母語：同一個專業，用不同語言寫出來**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **逐條寫明「**哪種手口需要哪種資料**」**，**並給出**記分規則**；**② **五個案件**給出判定與分數**（**含一個總分 0 但需要**重拍照片**的案件**）**；**③ **實測耗時**逐段列出**（**SMALL 倉庫下從零到全部跑完約 3 分半**）**。**⚠️ 全部資料自述為虛構。
e.summary_en: The repository insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson, written in Japanese, **is a hands-on exercise for artificial-intelligence-assisted motor insurance damage assessment and repair-estimate fraud detection**, described verbatim as matching four kinds of differently shaped data — accident vehicle images, repair shop estimate PDFs, reference masters of part prices and standard labour indices, and policy wording — on a single platform, and demonstrating how cases an adjuster should look at are surfaced mechanically. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-07**, **zero stars**, primarily a Jupyter notebook, **twenty-eight paths in the extracted archive** with five accident images, five reference images, one policy wording PDF, three estimate PDFs, two setup scripts, one notebook and two further SQL files, and **no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.** **Three things are worth reading**: it states pattern by pattern which fraud technique requires which data, and it writes the scoring rule down for each; it gives a verdict and a score for each of five demonstration cases, including one with a total score of zero that nonetheless needs the photographs retaken; and it lists measured runtimes step by step, with the whole exercise taking about three and a half minutes from a standing start on a small warehouse. **All data is stated to be fictional.**
e.body:
**insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson**（GitHub 仓库 `sfc-gh-kdaigo/insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson`，**全文日语**）**是一份**车险损害查定与修理估价舞弊检测的 AI 实操材料****——**README 逐字自述题材为**「**自動車事故の損害査定と修理見積の不正検知**」**，**并逐字写明方法**「**事故車の画像、修理工場から届く見積書PDF、部品定価・標準作業指数のリファレンスマスタ、そして保険約款という性質の異なる4種類のデータを1つのプラットフォーム上で突き合わせ、アジャスターが見るべき案件を機械的に浮かび上がらせるまでを体験します。**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 28 条路径**；**⚠️ 无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**母语：同一个专业，用不同语言写出来**」**。

**⭐ 引号约定**：**本条目所引 SQL 中原为 ASCII 单引号者一律写作**弯引号**（**U+2018 与 U+2019**）（**如** `‘ANY_REGION’` 与 `‘SNOWFLAKE_SSE’`**）**，**以便与条目自身的引号区分**。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 核心判断是一句：**每种手口需要的数据不同****——**逐字**：**「**厄介なのは、不正の手口ごとに検出に必要なデータが違うという点です。**」**，**并逐条列出四组**：**① **零件单价虚报** → **估价明细 ＋**零件定价主数据**；**② **工时指数虚报** → **估价明细 ＋**标准工时指数主数据**；**③ **虚假列项（**把没坏的地方也写上**）** → **估价明细 ＋**事故车图像**；**④ **型号不符的零件** → **估价明细 ＋**按型号的零件主数据**；**⭐ 随后逐字给出结论**：**「**価格マスタとの突合だけでは架空計上は見抜けず、画像分析だけでは単価の妥当性は判断できません。画像・PDF・マスタを同じ場所で突き合わせられることが、この検知を成立させています。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**一个检测器对应一种手口、**一种手口需要一组特定数据**」**被写成了一张**四行表**——**⭐ 而**结论句**说明**为什么这四类数据必须**在同一处**能对上**（**⭐ 只对价格主数据**看不出虚假列项，**只看图像**判断不了单价**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 343 轮「**四个维度**」、第 337 轮「**没有任何东西站在单一来源上**」同向**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 记分规则被**逐条写死，**而不是**留给模型自由发挥****——**本次实测的 README 逐字给出四项**：**① **图像一致性**——**图像上无法确认损伤的部位被列项**，**每件 30 分**；**② **零件单价**——**估价单价 > 定价 × 1.15**，**每件 25 分**；**③ **工时指数**——**估价指数 > 标准指数 × 1.30**，**每件 25 分**；**④ **零件编号**——**主数据中不存在**，**每件 15 分**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**要用 AI 挑出要人工看的案件**」**这件事**被拆成**四个可核的阈值**——**⭐ 而**阈值本身**写在文档里**（1.15 倍与 1.30 倍）**，**不是**藏在提示词里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 五个案件给出**判定、**分数与依据****——**实测 README 逐字列出**：**CLM-2024-0003（**ノート E13**）**要精査 **75 分**，**依据逐字为**「**画像の損傷は「左」ヘッドランプだが「右」を計上／マスタ未登録の部品番号**」**；**CLM-2024-0005（**ヤリスクロス**）**要精査 **55 分**，**依据为**「**左フロントフェンダ板金 指数9.5 vs 標準3.8（+150%）**」**；**CLM-2024-0004（**N-BOX JF5**）**要確認 **25 分**，**依据为**「**リヤバンパフェイス 46,800円 vs 定価 37,400円（+25%）**」**；**CLM-2024-0002（**アルファード**）**問題なし **0 分**；**⭐ CLM-2024-0001（**プリウス**）**問題なし **0 分****，**但理由栏逐字为**「**提出画像に損傷が写っておらず申告内容と不一致（再撮影対象）**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为最后这一条最值得记**：**⭐ 即**总分为 0 的案件**并没有被当成「**没事**」**——**它被标为**需要重拍照片**——**⭐ 这与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**分数为 0 与**无需处理**是两件事**。**⭐⭐ ④ 四类数据被放在**同一库的四个层**里，**且层与层之间的动作被命名****——**实测目录结构逐字为**：`INSURANCE_CLAIMS_DB` **下** `INTEGRATIONS`（**Git 集成**）、**`REPAIR_REFERENCE`**（**VEHICLES 5 件、**PARTS 33 件、**LABOR_INDEX 54 件、**LABOR_RATES 12 件**）、**`RAW`**（**CLM_CLAIMS 5 件、**CLM_IMAGES 10 件、**CLM_REPAIR_SHOPS 5 件、**CLM_ESTIMATES_RAW 3 件、**CLAIM_IMAGES_STAGE、**DOCS_STAGE**）、**`STAGING`**（**PARTS_MASTER 合并零件与指数、**DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT 图像 AI 原始结果、**ESTIMATE_DETAILS 估价明细、**YAKKAN_PARSED 约款解析、**YAKKAN_CHUNKS 约款分块**）、**`ANALYTICS`**（**DT_DAMAGE_ASSESSMENT 一行一部位、**DT_PRICE_ANOMALY 主数据核对结果、**DT_IMAGE_CONSISTENCY 图像一致性、**DT_FRAUD_RISK_SCORE 案件风险分、**DT_SHOP_PERFORMANCE 工场别实绩**）、**`APP`**（**YAKKAN_SEARCH_SVC 约款检索、**SV_CLAIMS 案件查询、**SV_FRAUD 舞弊分析、**CLAIMS_ADJUSTER_AGENT 协定业务助手**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**分层的名字本身就是一份说明书**：**主数据**、**原样数据**、**中间层**、**分析层**、**应用层**——**⭐ 即**「**原始数据不许直接进模型**」**被结构表达出来**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 用到的能力被列成表，**每项都写了用在哪****——**实测 README 逐字列出**：**FILE 类型与 `TO_FILE()`**（**在 notebook 单元格里直接显示stage 上的图像，**并把同一对象交给 AI**）、**`AI_COMPLETE`（**Vision**）**（**从事故车图像判定损伤部位、**程度与修法**）、**`response_format`**（**把输出固定为 OBJECT 型，**免去自由文本解析**）、**`AI_EXTRACT`**（**把估价单 PDF 的明细表结构化为一行一明细**）、**`AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT`**（**保留版式地文本化约款 PDF**）、**`SPLIT_TEXT_RECURSIVE_CHARACTER`**（**按条文近似分块**）、**Cortex Search**（**日语约款向量检索，**逐字给出用 `voyage-multilingual-2`**）、**Semantic View**（**自然语言生成 SQL**）、**Cortex Agent**（**跨结构化与非结构化数据的编排**）、**Dynamic Tables**（**把核对逻辑声明式地定义**）。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**把核对逻辑写成声明式的 Dynamic Table**」**这一条值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**什么算不一致**」**可以被**重新计算**，**而不必**每次跑一遍脚本**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 实测耗时逐段列出，**且区分「**跑」与「**讲」****——**实测 README 逐字给出**：**`git_setup.sql` 21 秒（**含讲解约 5 分**）、**`setup.sql` 46 秒（**约 10 分**）、**`src/01_ai_functions.ipynb` 63 秒（**约 40 分**）、**`src/02_cortex_search.sql` 46 秒（**约 15 分**）、**`src/03_cortex_agent.sql` 15 秒（**约 25 分**）**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**「**実行時間は SMALL ウェアハウスでの実測値です（ゼロ状態から通しで約3分半）**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**跑一遍要多久**」与「**讲一遍要多久**」**是两列**——**⭐ 这直接决定**这材料能否在一节课里讲完**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 环境前提被列成表，**且说明**为什么不需要本地上传****——**逐字**：**Snowflake 试用账号即可**、**角色 **`ACCOUNTADMIN`**、**区域任意**（**跨区推理在 `setup.sql` 里开启**）、**只需浏览器**（**不需要 SnowSQL 或 CLI**）**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**「**ファイルは Git 連携経由で Snowflake に取り込むため、参加者側での `PUT` 作業は発生しません**」**。**⭐ 即**把「**你不需要装什么**」**也写出来了**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 故障排查一节把**症状与原因**对应起来**——**实测逐字含**：**`COPY FILES` 不复制文件 → **未执行** `ALTER GIT REPOSITORY ... FETCH`**；**stage 上文件不可见／`DIRECTORY()` 为空 → **需要** `ALTER STAGE ... REFRESH`，**并逐字说明**「**Directory Table は自動更新されません**」；**`TO_FILE()` 图像不显示 → **检查 stage 是否用** `ENCRYPTION = (TYPE = ‘SNOWFLAKE_SSE’)`（**客户端加密的 stage 读不了 FILE 型**）、**须在 notebook 或 worksheet 结果网格里执行**、**并逐字指出**「**`BUILD_SCOPED_FILE_URL()` はURL文字列を返すだけで画像は表示されません**」；**`AI_COMPLETE` 报 Model is unavailable → **需** `ALTER ACCOUNT SET CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION = ‘ANY_REGION’`，**或**把模型从 `claude-sonnet-4-5` 换成** `pixtral-large`／`claude-4-sonnet`／`llama4-maverick`**；**`PROMPT()` 报「**第 1 参数必须是常量**」→ **改用占位符传列**；**日语列别名报语法错 → **别名要用双引号包起来**；**`AI_EXTRACT` 抽取值串到邻列 → （**README 该条在本次取回内容中未完整**，**⭐ 本词条不替它补全**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一节值得抄的地方是**它把「**看起来像平台坏了**」的几种情况**逐条归因**——**⭐ 与本站第 356 轮那条「**看起来像 Alpaca 在等重试**」是同一类写作**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 语言细节被当成问题写出来**——**逐字**「**日本語のカラム別名で構文エラーになる → `AS 見積額` のように日本語の別名を使う場合はダブルクォートで囲んでください**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处与**本轮主题**直接相关**：**⭐ 即**「**用日语做数据工程**」**会碰到**自己的语言带来的语法坑**——**⭐ 而它被写进了排查清单**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 数据性质与文件清单（实测）**——**逐字**：**「**データは全て架空のデモ用データです。実在の人物・企業・団体とは一切関係ありません。同梱の約款PDFもハンズオン用に作成した架空の約款です。**」**；**实测路径为** `data/images/claims/CLM-2024-0001_accident.jpg` **至** `-0005` **共 5 张**、**`data/images/reference/CLM-2024-0001_reference.jpg` 至** `-0005` **共 5 张**、**`data/pdf/auto_insurance_yakkan.pdf`**、**以及** `estimate_CLM-2024-0003.pdf`／`-0004.pdf`／`-0005.pdf` **三份**——**⭐ 即**五件案件里**只有三件附估价单**，**与 README 里** `CLM_ESTIMATES_RAW 見積書PDFメタ 3件` **一致**（**⭐ 本词条只并列这两个数，**不推测为何另两件没有**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[clausegraph]]、**[[medical-opinion-extractor]]、**[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] 覆盖条款与单据解析**，**[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]、**[[databricks-smart-claims]]、**[[aws-insurance-underwriting-genai]]、**[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 覆盖理赔与云上保险平台**，**[[parsr]] 一类条目覆盖文档抽取**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**四种性质不同的数据（**图像／**估价单 PDF／**主数据／**约款**）在同一处对撞 ＋**把每种手口的记分规则写死 ＋**把 AI 定位成**挑出要人工看的案件**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。**

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[clausegraph]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① **数据种类与手口对应**——**检测能力由**能对撞哪些数据**决定，**而不是**由模型大小决定**；**② **记分阈值写明**（**1.15 倍、**1.30 倍**）**，**而**不是藏在提示词里**；**③ **分数为 0 ≠ 无需处理**（**该重拍照片就要写出来**）**；**④ **把「**跑一遍多久／讲一遍多久**」分成两列**。

The repository insurance-claims-snowflake-cortex-handson, written entirely in Japanese, **is a hands-on exercise for artificial-intelligence-assisted motor insurance damage assessment and repair-estimate fraud detection**, described verbatim as matching four kinds of differently shaped data — accident vehicle images, repair shop estimate PDFs, reference masters of part prices and standard labour indices, and policy wording — on a single platform, and demonstrating how cases an adjuster should look at are surfaced mechanically. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-07**, **last pushed 2026-09-07**, **zero stars**, primarily a Jupyter notebook, **twenty-eight paths in the extracted archive**, and **no licence file**, which this entry records as unclear rights. **This entry belongs to the round theme of one profession written in different languages.**

**Quotation convention**: SQL literals that were written with ASCII single quotes are reproduced here with typographic single quotes, for instance the cross-region setting value, so that they are distinguishable from the quotation marks of this entry itself.

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the central judgement is one sentence: each fraud technique needs different data**: verbatim, the awkward part is that the data required for detection differs by technique, followed by a four-row table in which inflated part unit prices need the estimate lines plus the part price master, inflated labour indices need the estimate lines plus the standard labour index master, fabricated line items for undamaged parts need the estimate lines plus the accident vehicle images, and wrong-model parts need the estimate lines plus the model-specific parts master; the conclusion is then stated verbatim, that matching against the price master alone cannot see through a fabricated line item and image analysis alone cannot judge whether a unit price is reasonable, and that being able to match images, PDFs and masters in the same place is what makes the detection possible. **One detector per technique, and each technique needing its own specific data, is written down as a four-row table, and the closing sentence explains why those four kinds of data must be matchable in one place.** **Second, the scoring rules are written down rather than left to the model**: four checks with points each — image consistency, where a part whose damage cannot be confirmed in the image is billed, at thirty points per item; part unit price, where the estimated price exceeds the list price by more than fifteen percent, at twenty-five points per item; labour index, where the estimated index exceeds the standard index by more than thirty percent, at twenty-five points per item; and part number, where the number does not exist in the master, at fifteen points per item. **Turning detection into a few checkable thresholds whose values are written in the documentation rather than buried in a prompt is the point worth copying.** **Third, five cases receive a verdict, a score and a stated basis**: one case scores seventy-five and is marked for close review on the grounds that the image shows damage to the left headlamp while the right one was billed and that a part number is absent from the master; a second scores fifty-five and is marked for close review because a panel labour index of nine point five against a standard three point eight is a hundred and fifty percent above standard; a third scores twenty-five and is marked for confirmation because a rear bumper fascia was estimated at forty-six thousand eight hundred yen against a list price of thirty-seven thousand four hundred, twenty-five percent above; and two cases score zero with no problem found. **The last of those carries a stated reason that the submitted photograph shows no damage and does not match the declaration, and is therefore marked as needing to be re-photographed: a zero score is not the same as requiring no action.** **Fourth, the four kinds of data sit in four named layers of one database**, with an integrations layer, a repair reference layer containing five vehicles, thirty-three parts, fifty-four labour indices and twelve labour rates, a raw layer holding the claims, images, repair shops, estimate metadata and two staging areas, a staging layer joining parts with indices and holding image analysis output, structured estimate lines and parsed and chunked policy text, an analytics layer with one row per damaged part, master-matching results, image consistency checks, a per-case risk score and per-shop performance, and an application layer with policy search, a claims semantic view, a fraud semantic view and an adjuster assistant. **The layer names are themselves documentation, and the separation expresses the rule that raw data must not go straight into a model.** **Fifth, the platform capabilities used are listed with where each is used**: a file type and its display function so an image on a stage can be shown inside a notebook cell and passed on as the same object, a vision completion function that judges damaged parts and repair methods from accident photographs, a response-format setting that fixes output to a structured object and removes free-text parsing, a table extraction function that turns an estimate PDF into one row per line item, a layout-preserving document parser for policy wording, a recursive text splitter, a Japanese-language vector search with the embedding model named verbatim, a semantic view for natural-language SQL, an agent for orchestration across structured and unstructured data, and dynamic tables that define the matching logic declaratively. **Defining the matching logic as a declarative dynamic table is worth noting separately, because what counts as inconsistent can then be recomputed rather than re-scripted.** **Sixth, the measured runtimes are listed step by step and separated from teaching time**: twenty-one seconds for the Git setup, forty-six for environment setup, sixty-three for the notebook, forty-six for the search step and fifteen for the agent step, with the readme stating verbatim that the times are measured on a small warehouse and that the whole run takes about three and a half minutes from a standing start, while the accompanying explanation time is given as roughly five, ten, forty, fifteen and twenty-five minutes. **How long it takes to run and how long it takes to teach are two different columns, and that directly determines whether the material fits in one class.** **Seventh, the prerequisites are tabulated and it is stated why no local upload is needed**: a trial account suffices, the account administrator role is required, any region works because cross-region inference is enabled by the setup script, and only a browser is needed, with the readme stating verbatim that files are imported through Git integration so participants never have to run an upload command. **What you do not need to install is stated as well.** **Eighth, the troubleshooting section maps symptoms to causes**: files not being copied means the fetch step was not run; an empty directory listing needs a stage refresh, with the readme stating verbatim that the directory table does not update automatically; an image not displaying requires the stage to use server-side encryption because a client-side encrypted stage cannot read the file type, requires execution in a notebook or result grid, and is accompanied by the note that the URL-building function returns only a URL string and does not display the image; a model-unavailable error requires enabling cross-region inference at the account level or switching to one of three named alternative models; a prompt function error means the first argument must be constant and columns must be passed as placeholders; and a syntax error with a Japanese column alias means the alias must be quoted. **Attributing the failures that look like a broken platform is the same kind of writing as describing a failure that looks like a tool waiting out its retries.** **Ninth, a language detail is treated as a problem worth documenting**: Japanese column aliases cause syntax errors unless enclosed in double quotes, which this entry notes is directly relevant to the round theme, because doing data engineering in Japanese runs into syntax traps created by the language itself. **Tenth, the data is declared fictional and the file listing was measured**: the readme states verbatim that all data is fictional demonstration data unrelated to any real person, company or organisation and that the bundled policy wording PDF was created for the exercise; the measured paths contain five accident images, five reference images, one policy PDF, and only three estimate PDFs, which agrees with the stated count of three estimate records and is recorded here as two parallel numbers without speculating as to why the other two cases have none. **Eleventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover policy and document parsing, claims and cloud insurance platform material and document extraction, **while this entry supplies four differently shaped data kinds matched in one place, a written scoring rule per fraud technique, and an agent positioned as surfacing the cases a human must review. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled clause-graph and claims-analytics entries**; **four practices transfer directly: detection capability is set by which data kinds can be matched rather than by model size; write the scoring thresholds down instead of hiding them in a prompt; a zero score is not the same as requiring no action; and split how long a run takes from how long a class takes**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no platform account opened, no SQL or notebook executed, no platform function called and no case score or runtime recomputed — **so this entry claims neither the verdicts and scores, nor that the layered structure can actually be built, nor the runtimes**. **Second, no code was read**: only the readme and the archive path list were read, and neither setup script, none of the three files under the source directory and no image or PDF was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the full text of one troubleshooting entry about extracted values shifting into an adjacent column could not be read**, because the retrieved readme was truncated at that point, and this entry does not complete it. **Fourth, whether the platform functions and dynamic-table syntax exist in the current platform version was not verified**, no vendor documentation having been consulted, nor was it verified whether the named embedding model is still the default. **Fifth, the environment behind the measured times was not verified**, only the warehouse size being stated. **Sixth, whether the images and estimate PDFs actually correspond to the stated verdicts was not verified**, no image or PDF having been viewed, **so this entry relays the readme verdicts and does not claim that the detection logic is correct**. **Seventh, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the readme gives no licence terms verbatim, **which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, and since the material involves a cloud platform and third-party models their terms apply separately. **Eighth, the author identity was not verified**, the account name prefix following that vendor internal naming convention but no identity or affiliation having been confirmed; the repository has zero stars, no tests and no continuous integration. **Ninth, the declaration that all data is fictional was not verified**, this entry relaying it only, and anyone reusing the demonstration data must still confirm that no third-party rights attach. **Tenth, whether the material matches any real insurer claims process was not verified**, and nothing here may be read as an opinion on any claim or any fraud determination. **Eleventh, both the creation and the push fall on 2026-09-07, inside the thaw window, so this entry has no window exception to declare. Twelfth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
